name: ppp-calculator
description: PPP Calculator — Same money. Different prices. (Cloudflare Workers assets)

scripts.sync-assets: mkdir -p public/data && cp index.html public/index.html && cp app.js public/app.js && cp styles.css public/styles.css && cp robots.txt public/robots.txt && cp sitemap.xml public/sitemap.xml && cp favicon.svg public/favicon.svg && cp data/countries.json public/data/countries.json && cp data/commodities.json public/data/commodities.json
scripts.deploy:v2: npm run sync-assets-v2 && wrangler deploy -c wrangler.v2.jsonc
scripts.dev:v2: npm run sync-assets-v2 && wrangler dev -c wrangler.v2.jsonc
